summary: Tested Point Measurements (stake-out distances) and the Drainage-only PDF, backend and frontend, at 1920px. Backend: 7/7 pytest pass. POST /report crew=drainage returns a 7-page PDF named *_drainage_report.pdf on project eb4fb34f. It has the 'In this report' list, the layout image with corner markers C1..C8 and dashed stake lines with ft-in labels, a stake-out table with all 8 items (CO-1..CO-6, SUMP, SP-2), the drainage material takeoff and the checklist. Project c5675b5d works too. A project with no layout returns 400 'Draw the drain tile layout on the foundation sheet first'; an unknown project returns 404; the full, foundation and waterproofing crews still return PDFs. Frontend: the Stake-out layer checkbox is on by default. 8 corner labels, 8 stake lines and 8 list rows show, and the list values match the PDF table exactly. Toggling the layer hides and shows layout-stakes. Clicking a row selects the item: the inspector shows Cleanout (label CO-3), Main sump or Sump / pump, the row is highlighted and the stake label turns amber. Dragging CO-1 updates the list and drawing live (1'-7" -> 9'-3" mid-drag -> 10'-8"), and the nearest corner changes (C1 -> C7 -> C4 -> C5). Dragging the main sump: 5'-0" -> 6'-3" -> 12'-7", corner C7 -> C4. + Cleanout adds row CO-7 with a stake line; Delete removes it; deleting CO-1 re-indexes the rows correctly. Discard restores everything. On manual 'Draw it myself' on FD2, stakeout-no-corners shows (also after adding a cleanout); after tracing the footing, rows show '—' plus the 'Enter the measured tile length' hint. Report dialog: report-type-drainage shows report-drainage-note (the checklist text only appears when the drainage tool is ready), hides the images and Q&A toggles, and downloads 2612163R2_with_detail_sheets_1__drainage_report.pdf (266KB). A project with no layout shows the error toast and the dialog stays open. No page errors. Saved layouts were not changed (checked through the API afterwards).

ui_bugs.issue: open-report-dialog-button is disabled={!scanned}. A project with a manual drain layout but 0 scanned sheets can never open the dialog to get the Drainage only report, even though the backend drainage report does not need scans. Seen on bbed49f5 (0/1 scanned). Enable the button when any page has drain_status==='ready'; the download button already blocks only 'full' when there are no scans.

design_issues.screen: Drain layout FD1 canvas and PDF layout image
issues: The footing covers only about 25% of the sheet, and cleanouts sit 1.5-3 ft from the corners. So the stake labels, corner labels C1..C8, cleanout labels and segment-length labels all pile up on top of each other near the corners, and several distance labels are not readable (also in the PDF page 2 image). Ideas: offset stake labels outward from the footing, use leader lines, and/or crop or zoom the PDF image to the footing extents. The stake-out table on the next PDF page stays readable.
With the drainage type there are no toggles, but the border-t wrapper div still draws an empty divider line above the Download button.
The 5-option type toggle wraps 'Waterproofing crew' onto 2 lines (minor).

action_items: Enable the PDF report button (SetToolbar) when the project has any saved drain layout, even with 0 scanned sheets, so 'Drainage only' can be reached
Reduce stake-label clutter on the canvas and in the PDF render: offset labels, or crop the PDF layout image to the footing bbox
Hide the empty divider in ReportDialog when crew==='drainage'
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend (geometry.stakeouts: SVG units * k) and backend (overlay.stakeouts: px * ft_per_px) give identical results (checked across 8 items), good
overlay.stakeouts falls back to length_ft / tile px only when ft_per_px is missing. This matches the frontend ftPerUnit, but a draft calibrated with _k is only right after saving (expected)

Manual layout: if a length is typed before any drain tile exists, svgLen=0, so _k=0 and distances stay '—' while the hint still says 'Enter the measured tile length'. This edge case could confuse users; the hint could say 'Draw the drain tile, then enter its length'

Before the sheet image loads, the live length showed 137.4 LF; it was 138.2 once loaded. Aspect defaults until the image loads, so stake distances can show slightly wrong values for a moment (cosmetic)

success_rate.frontend: ~93% (all requested flows pass; 1 medium gating issue: report button disabled when 0 scans)
